issues.name: raw UE1 serialized name bytes not stored alongside decoded NameMap
issues.proof: The 83-path operation inventory identifies name display, import/export names, dependency matching, metadata search/publishing and original file SHA/size checks. CatalogUE1PackageReader reads original bytes; Uedb5UE1TableSnapshotBuilder stores decoded text + flags + original entry offset; CatalogLegacyNameMapPreprocessor and Uedb5ClassicDependencyResolver consume decoded names; Uedb5MetadataContainer writes only independent UEDB5 metadata, not a rewritten Unreal package. No active UE1 package roundtrip writer/repacker requires exact name-archive bytes.
